summary_en: Nichicon purchased 1,922,300 shares for 4.999 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 at 2,601 yen per share on September 3, 2026, representing 2.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Block Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 2, 2026, Nichicon's board of directors authorized execution of a single block purchase of treasury stock via the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transaction system. The purchase was conducted at 2,601 yen per share, matching the closing price of ordinary shares on the exchange that day. A total of 1,922,300 shares were purchased for approximately 4.999 billion yen, representing 2.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

This block transaction was conducted within the broader authorization approved on the same date, which set an upper limit of 2,248,000 shares (3.35% of outstanding shares) and 5 billion yen for share purchases during the period of September 3, 2026. The purchase order was executed during the single ToSTNeT-3 session on September 3, 2026 at 8:45 a.m., with results to be announced upon conclusion of that trading session. The disclosure notes that market conditions could have resulted in partial or complete non-execution of the order.
